Public nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Privileged owner address set in the constructor to msg.sender.
Mapping counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and consulted by condition.
Mapping of whitelisted sellers; set true by _mints and read by ensure.
Minimum sale amount set by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount set by init and enforced in condition.
Number of allowed sales per address set by init and enforced in condition.
Exempt trade address set by owner via setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Constant public decimals value (18) used in scaling arithmetic.
Public token name assigned in the constructor.
Public token symbol assigned in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom for msg.sender.
Internal view whitelist check that inspects owner, UNI pair and canSale before condition.
Public payable transfer entry point handling allowance, ensure, and unchecked balance updates.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing per-address sale count and min/max sale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and data.
Owner or hardcoded-address gated mint that sets balances and whitelists the spender.
Owner-only initializer of sale limits and sale count.
Owner-only loop that sends tokens to many recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress exemption variable.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address derivation via keccak256 of token pair.
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and initial balances.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and transfer origin across SpaceMusk.
Unchecked subtraction of balanceOf[_from] and increment of balanceOf[_to] outside SafeMath.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance arithmetic in the batch loop.
Unchecked addedValue * 10**decimals assignment to balanceOf[spender].
Source address parameter of transferFrom, used in ensure and balance updates.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, compared against allowance and balance.

Account parameter of _mints whose balance and whitelist flag are written.
Amount parameter of _mints used in unchecked scaling arithmetic.
Array of recipient addresses iterated by batchSend.

New trade address written into the tradeAddress state variable.
Amount parameter of transfer forwarded to transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit transfer origin in transferFrom and dictates allowance accounting.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall in delegate.
msg.sender is checked against owner and hardcoded addresses in _mints.
msg.sender must equal owner to run init.
msg.sender must equal owner to run batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the whole supply in the constructor.
_from parameter is read into ensure and balance updates of transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives allowance, balance and condition checks in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes ensure for whitelist validation.
ensure falls back to condition for non-whitelisted senders.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
Unchecked arithmetic directly mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
batchSend computes total and loop balances without overflow checks.
_mints performs unchecked multiplication when setting balances.
delegate forwards its arguments into the low-level delegatecall.
Target address a is consumed by the delegatecall.
Calldata b is forwarded to the delegatecall.
spender parameter is written to balanceOf and canSale in _mints.
addedValue parameter feeds unchecked scaling arithmetic in _mints.
_tos array is iterated as recipients inside batchSend.
_value parameter is multiplied by array length and credited to recipients.
Local total derives from unchecked multiplication of _value and _tos.length.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
transfer amount is forwarded along the transfer to transferFrom path.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure grants unrestricted transfers when _from or _to is the privileged owner.
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum counter for the sender.
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes balances with unchecked subtraction.
canSale whitelist bypasses the condition check in ensure.
tradeAddress holder bypasses the sale condition in ensure.
_minSale bounds the value accepted by condition.
_maxSale bounds the value accepted by condition.
_saleNum limits how many transfers an address may make in condition.
Arbitrary delegatecall executes untrusted code in the contract context, allowing state re-entry.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient parameter of transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
_to is a transient parameter of transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
_value is a transient parameter of transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Target address a is only meaningful inside the delegate function.
Calldata b is only meaningful inside the delegate function.
spender is a transient parameter of _mints and should be folded into that function node.
addedValue directly feeds the unchecked multiplication in _mints.
_tos is a transient parameter iterated by batchSend.
_value is the operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
addr is a transient parameter written to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress.
The transfer amount parameter is forwarded by transfer to transferFrom.
Local total exists only for the unchecked arithmetic inside batchSend.
